name: Houseki Doll
source:
"...What is the use for dolls that can't even fulfill their role?"
This is a story about a girl who worries about her own worth and a doll boy who has lost his value.

It was the long-awaited summer vacation.
Shiori was forced to help out at her family's coffee shop, where she met 'Nekome', who has beautiful jewel-like eyes.
Shiori soon became friends with the soft-spoken but somehow mysterious Nekome.
"I'll do my best to brew coffee that you'll say tastes good", he said.

Accompanied by the junior colleague Hazuki, Nekome visits a certain coffee shop.
He didn't dislike the coffee he drinks there, nor did he dislike the girl he met.
But his eyes were looking at a faraway place, different from here.
"Is this what we need? We're ......."

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/2972]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
“…连职责都无法完成的人偶，又有什么价值？”
一个为自身价值苦恼的少女，与失去价值的人偶少年之间的故事。

期盼已久的暑假，终于到来。
诗织被迫帮忙打理家中的咖啡馆，在那里遇见了有着宝石般美丽双眼的“猫目”。
猫目不善言辞，却透着几分神秘，诗织很快与他成为朋友。
“我会努力泡出让你也说好喝的咖啡。”

在后辈叶月的陪伴下，猫目来到某家咖啡馆。
他并不讨厌在那里喝的咖啡，也不讨厌遇见的那个女孩。
可他的双眼，却始终望向与此处不同的遥远地方。
“这就是我们需要的吗？我们……”

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/2972]NovelGame[/url]]
